visualCharacteristics.structure: image + heading + text + link + video + field
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontally scrolling row of promo, offer or article cards with prev/next arrows and a progress bar, optionally beside an intro panel; text-slides options turn it into one centred text slide at a time with dots

contentPattern.structure: Optional first row: one cell with an h2 intro (logo image, heading, text, link) shown beside the cards. Every following row is one card: an optional picture-only cell (card image) plus a body cell (heading, text, links/buttons). With text-slides / text-slides-2 each row is one full-width text slide (heading, text, link) and there is no intro row. Empty rows and cells are ignored

reuseGuidance: Use for any scrolling set of 3+ cards or rotating text slides. Use carousel-hero for full-width hero slides. Colour options (alt, blue, blue-light, blue-cyan, blue-purple) are styled in the design pass
